Body Mass Index Variability and Cardiovascular Risk: Contemporary Evidence and Clinical Implications for Diabetes Care
summary: Purpose of review To synthesize contemporary evidence on body mass index (BMI) variability as a determinant of cardiovascular risk, integrate mechanistic insights, and clarify its clinical relevance in individuals with and without diabetes.Recent findings Large cohort studies demonstrate that greater BMI or weight variability is associated with increased risks of all-cause mortality, atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, heart failure and atrial fibrillation, independent of mean BMI. Mechanistic evidence to explain the observed association implicates adipose tissue dysfunction, ectopic fat deposition, metabolic instability, systemic inflammation, and autonomic imbalance. Diabetes may amplify these pathways through impaired metabolic flexibility and treatment-related weight fluctuations. Evidence from diabetes-specific cohorts suggests that structured, intentional weight loss may attenuate the adverse associations seen with unstructured weight cycling. BMI variability is an emerging marker of cardiometabolic instability with implications for cardiovascular risk, particularly in diabetes. Defining actionable thresholds and determining whether stabilizing weight improves outcomes are key future research priorities.

AI.method: 本文为综述，综合大型队列研究及机制证据，探讨BMI变异性与心血管风险的关系，纳入对象包括糖尿病和非糖尿病人群，未报告系统检索策略、样本量及定量合并分析。
AI.result: 大型队列研究显示，BMI或体重变异性越大，全因死亡、动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病、心衰和房颤风险越高，且独立于平均BMI；机制涉及脂肪组织功能障碍、异位脂肪沉积、代谢不稳定、全身炎症和自主神经失衡；糖尿病相关队列提示结构化有意减重可能减轻非结构化体重循环的不良关联。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: BMI变异性是反映心脏代谢不稳定的新兴标志物，对心血管风险尤其糖尿病患者的评估有潜在价值；但可操作阈值未定，稳定体重能否改善结局尚待研究，临床应关注体重波动并优先结构化减重。

Ventricular Tachycardia Ablation in Late-Onset Phenotype Fabry Disease: A Case Report
summary: Abstract Background Fabry disease is an X-linked lysosomal storage disorder that can cause progressive cardiomyopathy, myocardial fibrosis, conduction disease, and malignant ventricular arrhythmias. Ventricular tachycardia (VT) ablation in advanced Fabry cardiomyopathy is challenging, particularly in patients with extensive scar and left ventricular assist device (LVAD) support. Case summary A 71-year-old man with late-onset Fabry disease, confirmed by endomyocardial biopsy showing myelin body accumulation, reduced α-galactosidase A activity, elevated plasma Gb3, developed severe left ventricular dysfunction, extensive late gadolinium enhancement, LVAD implantation, and complete atrioventricular block requiring dual-chamber pacemaker implantation. He presented with recurrent palpitations and near-syncope. Device interrogation revealed multiple VT episodes, including one episode degenerating into ventricular fibrillation, and surface electrocardiography documented wide-complex tachycardia with right bundle branch block morphology and an inferior axis. An electrophysiological study was performed using an antegrade transseptal left ventricular approach. Intracardiac echocardiography was used to delineate the LV cavity and LVAD position, facilitating safe catheter navigation and mapping while avoiding interference with the LVAD. Endocardial mapping demonstrated diffuse late potentials, low-voltage substrate, and deceleration zones involving the basal-to-mid inferolateral left ventricle. Substrate modification targeting these abnormal electrograms eliminated inducible ventricular premature complexes. No recurrent VT episodes were detected on subsequent pacemaker interrogation. Discussion This case highlights the complex arrhythmogenic substrate of late-stage Fabry cardiomyopathy and the utility of intracardiac echocardiography-guided mapping in patients with LVAD support. Catheter ablation may provide short-term arrhythmia control, but in advanced Fabry disease, its role remains largely palliative.

AI.tldr: 71岁晚发型Fabry病伴LVAD患者，经心内超声引导下经房间隔左室途径行VT消融，靶向基底至中段下侧壁晚电位，术后起搏器未再记录到VT。
AI.motivation: Fabry病可导致进行性心肌病、心肌纤维化及恶性室性心律失常，晚期患者常合并广泛瘢痕和左室辅助装置（LVAD），使VT消融极具挑战；既往此类病例经验有限，需探索安全有效的标测与消融策略。
AI.method: 病例报告。患者为71岁男性晚发型Fabry病（心内膜心肌活检见髓鞘样体沉积、α-半乳糖苷酶A活性降低、血浆Gb3升高），合并严重左室功能不全、广泛延迟钆增强、LVAD植入及完全性房室传导阻滞（已植入双腔起搏器）。因反复心悸、近乎晕厥，起搏器记录到多次VT（其中一次蜕变为室颤），体表心电图示右束支阻滞形态、下壁轴宽QRS心动过速。行电生理检查，采用经房间隔顺行左室途径，心内超声心动图 delineate 左室腔及LVAD位置以安全导航和标测。行基质标测及消融，靶向异常电图。
AI.result: 心内膜标测显示弥漫晚电位、低电压基质及减速区，累及基底至中段下侧壁左室。针对这些异常电图行基质改良后，可诱发的室性早搏被消除。后续起搏器 interrogation 未检测到VT复发。摘要未报告具体随访时长及统计数值。
AI.conclusion: 本病例提示晚期Fabry心肌病具有复杂的致心律失常基质，心内超声引导下标测对LVAD支持患者安全可行；导管消融可能提供短期心律失常控制，但在晚期Fabry病中其作用主要为姑息性。临床意义在于为这类高危患者提供了一种可借鉴的消融策略，但长期疗效及对预后的影响尚不明确，需更多研究。

摘要

背景：Fabry病是一种X连锁溶酶体贮积病，可导致进行性心肌病、心肌纤维化、传导系统疾病和恶性室性心律失常。在晚期Fabry心肌病中进行室性心动过速（VT）消融具有挑战性，尤其是在存在广泛瘢痕和左心室辅助装置（LVAD）支持的患者中。

讨论：本病例突出了晚期Fabry心肌病复杂的致心律失常基质，以及心腔内超声心动图引导标测在LVAD支持患者中的实用性。导管消融可能提供短期心律失常控制，但在晚期Fabry病中，其作用在很大程度上仍是姑息性的。

title: Left Bundle Branch Area Pacing Improves Atrial Function and Reverses Atrial Remodeling in Dyssynchrony Heart Failure Model
summary: Background Left bundle branch area pacing may reduce new-onset atrial fibrillation. However, its mechanism and the comparison of atrial reverse remodeling effect between left bundle branch pacing (LBBP) and left ventricular septal pacing (LVSP) has not been elucidated. We aim to investigate reverse atrial remodeling by LBBP and LVSP in a canine model of rapid pacing-induced dyssynchronous heart failure (DHF).Methods Twenty-six beagles followed a 6-week protocol: controls (n=4), rapid atrial pacing (n=4), DHF (n=6), DHF+LBBP and DHF+LVSP (3 weeks DHF followed by 3 weeks LBBP or LVSP, both n=6). Atrial emptying fraction, functional, and electrophysiological parameters were dynamically assessed. Atrial fibrosis was analyzed in tissue samples.Results Within 3 weeks DHF increased atrial volumes and diminished RA and LA emptying fraction and strains significantly compared with baseline. Subsequent 3 weeks of LBBP increased emptying fraction and strains significantly. At week 6, P-wave duration was shorter in DHF+LBBP than in DHF. Atrial fibrillation was only inducible in DHF animals. Left atrial appendage levels of collagen I/III and α-SMA deposition and fibrosis were lower in DHF+LBBP compared with DHF animals. LBBP reversed atrial structural and electrical parameters to the levels in rapid atrial pacing animals. LVSP improved those parameters compared with those in DHF but did not normalize them to the levels in the rapid atrial pacing animals.Conclusions LBBP significantly reverses DHF-induced functional, cellular, and molecular remodeling in the atria, while a smaller amelioration is achieved with LVSP. The findings may explain the reduction in new-onset atrial fibrillation after LBBP.

AI.tldr: 在快速起搏诱导的犬失同步心衰模型中，左束支区域起搏（LBBP）可显著逆转心房功能、细胞和分子重构，效果优于左室间隔起搏（LVSP），或可解释LBBP后新发房颤减少。
AI.motivation: LBBP可能减少新发房颤，但其机制及LBBP与LVSP对心房逆重构作用的比较尚未阐明。本研究旨在犬快速起搏诱导的失同步心衰（DHF）模型中探讨LBBP和LVSP的心房逆重构效应。
AI.method: 26只比格犬分为对照组（n=4）、快速心房起搏组（n=4）、DHF组（n=6）、DHF+LBBP组和DHF+LVSP组（先3周DHF后3周LBBP或LVSP，各n=6）。动态评估心房排空分数、功能和电生理参数，并分析心房组织纤维化。
AI.result: 3周DHF较基线显著增加心房容积、降低左右心房排空分数和应变。后续3周LBBP显著提高排空分数和应变。第6周时DHF+LBBP组P波时限短于DHF组。房颤仅在DHF动物中可诱发。DHF+LBBP组左心耳I/III型胶原、α-SMA沉积和纤维化低于DHF组。LBBP使心房结构和电参数恢复至快速心房起搏组水平；LVSP较DHF组改善但未恢复正常。
AI.conclusion: LBBP可显著逆转DHF诱导的心房功能、细胞和分子重构，LVSP改善程度较小。该发现或可解释LBBP后新发房颤减少，支持LBBP在失同步心衰中作为心房逆重构策略的潜在价值，但需临床研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：左束支区域起搏可能减少新发心房颤动。然而，其机制以及左束支起搏（LBBP）与左室间隔起搏（LVSP）对心房逆重构效应的比较尚未阐明。我们旨在研究在快速起搏诱导的失同步心力衰竭（DHF）犬模型中，LBBP和LVSP对心房逆重构的影响。

方法：26只比格犬遵循6周方案：对照组（n=4）、快速心房起搏组（n=4）、DHF组（n=6）、DHF+LBBP组和DHF+LVSP组（先3周DHF，随后3周LBBP或LVSP，每组n=6）。动态评估心房排空分数、功能和电生理参数。分析组织样本中的心房纤维化。

结果：与基线相比，3周内DHF显著增加心房容积并降低右房和左房排空分数及应变。随后3周的LBBP显著增加排空分数和应变。在第6周，DHF+LBBP组的P波时限短于DHF组。心房颤动仅在DHF动物中可诱发。与DHF动物相比，DHF+LBBP组左心耳I/III型胶原和α-SMA沉积水平及纤维化较低。LBBP将心房结构和电参数逆转至快速心房起搏动物的水平。与DHF组相比，LVSP改善了这些参数，但未将其恢复至快速心房起搏动物的水平。

结论：LBBP显著逆转DHF诱导的心房功能、细胞和分子重构，而LVSP仅实现较小程度的改善。这些发现可能解释LBBP后新发心房颤动的减少。

title: Left Atrial Enlargement Identifies Risk of Stroke Independent of Atrial Fibrillation
summary: Background Left atrial (LA) enlargement has been proposed to increase stroke risk independent of atrial fibrillation (AF), but evidence accounting for AF over time is limited. We tested whether the association between LA enlargement and stroke persist independent of new-onset AF.Methods In this observational study, participants from the Copenhagen General Population Study underwent cardiac computed tomography from 2010 through 2018 and were followed until December 2022. LA volume was indexed to body surface area. LA enlargement was defined using sex-specific cutoffs. The primary outcome was incident stroke. Secondary outcomes were incident AF, heart failure, dementia, and all-cause mortality. Individuals with baseline AF were excluded. Hazard ratios (HRs) were estimated using cause-specific Cox models with AF modeled as a time-varying covariate.Results Among 10 024 individuals (mean age 60 years, 57% women), 684 (6.8%) had LA enlargement. Over a median follow-up of 7.3 years stroke occurred in 356 individuals (3.6%). LA enlargement was associated with a higher absolute risk of stroke (11.1% versus 4.6%, risk difference 6.5% [95% CI, 2.4-10.6]) and an increased hazard (adjusted HR, 1.49 [95% CI, 1.09-2.05]; P=0.013), which remained similar after adjustment for incident AF, and in separate models using the CHA2DS2-VA score and P-wave terminal force in lead V1. LA enlargement was also associated with higher risk of AF (HR, 3.77 [95% CI, 3.00-4.73]) and heart failure (HR, 3.59 [95% CI, 2.54-5.06]) but not with dementia or all-cause mortality.Conclusions LA enlargement was associated with incident stroke independent of incident AF, supporting LA enlargement as a marker of thromboembolic risk.

AI.tldr: 在无房颤人群中，左房扩大与卒中风险独立相关（HR 1.49），且不依赖于新发房颤，提示左房扩大可作为血栓栓塞风险的标志。
AI.motivation: 左房扩大被提出可独立于房颤增加卒中风险，但既往证据对随时间变化的房颤状态调整有限，左房扩大与卒中的关联是否独立于新发房颤尚不明确。
AI.method: 基于哥本哈根普通人群研究的观察性研究，纳入2010-2018年接受心脏计算机断层扫描且基线无房颤的参与者，左房容积经体表面积指数化，采用性别特异性切点定义左房扩大。主要终点为 incident stroke，次要终点为新发房颤、心力衰竭、痴呆和全因死亡。采用病因特异性 Cox 模型，房颤作为时变协变量，并计算风险比（HR）。
AI.result: 共纳入10,024人（平均年龄60岁，57%女性），684人（6.8%）有左房扩大。中位随访7.3年，356人（3.6%）发生卒中。左房扩大与更高的卒中绝对风险相关（11.1% vs 4.6%，风险差6.5% [95% CI, 2.4-10.6]），校正后 HR 为1.49（95% CI, 1.09-2.05；P=0.013），进一步校正新发房颤、CHA2DS2-VA 评分及 V1 导联 P 波终末电势后结果相似。左房扩大还与房颤（HR 3.77 [95% CI, 3.00-4.73]）和心力衰竭（HR 3.59 [95% CI, 2.54-5.06]）风险升高相关，但与痴呆或全因死亡无关。
AI.conclusion: 左房扩大与新发卒中独立相关，且独立于新发房颤，支持左房扩大作为血栓栓塞风险的标志物。该发现提示在房颤评估中应关注左房结构改变，但研究为观察性设计，残余混杂可能影响因果推断，需进一步验证。

summary_zh:
背景：左心房（LA）扩大已被提出可独立于心房颤动（AF）增加卒中风险，但考虑随时间发生的AF的证据有限。我们检验了LA扩大与卒中之间的关联是否独立于新发AF而持续存在。

方法：在这项观察性研究中，来自哥本哈根普通人群研究的参与者在2010年至2018年期间接受了心脏计算机断层扫描，并随访至2022年12月。LA容积按体表面积进行指数化。LA扩大使用性别特异性截断值定义。主要结局为 incident stroke。次要结局为 incident AF、心力衰竭、痴呆和全因死亡率。基线AF个体被排除。风险比（HRs）使用病因特异性Cox模型估计，其中AF作为时变协变量建模。

结果：在10 024名个体中（平均年龄60岁，57%为女性），684人（6.8%）存在LA扩大。在中位随访7.3年期间，356人（3.6%）发生卒中。LA扩大与更高的卒中绝对风险相关（11.1% 对 4.6%，风险差 6.5% [95% CI, 2.4-10.6]）和增加的风险比（调整后HR，1.49 [95% CI, 1.09-2.05]；P=0.013），在调整 incident AF后以及在使用CHA2DS2-VA评分和V1导联P波终末电势的单独模型中，该关联保持相似。LA扩大还与更高的AF风险（HR，3.77 [95% CI, 3.00-4.73]）和心力衰竭风险（HR，3.59 [95% CI, 2.54-5.06]）相关，但与痴呆或全因死亡率无关。

结论：LA扩大与 incident stroke 相关，独立于 incident AF，支持LA扩大作为血栓栓塞风险的标志物。

title: First-in-human experience and one-year outcomes using a novel conformal pulsed-field ablation balloon catheter for pulmonary vein isolation in paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
summary: Background Thermal balloon catheters have improved the efficiency of pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) in atrial fibrillation (AF). Reports assessing additional safety and effectiveness of pulsed field ablation (PFA) balloon catheters for PVI are limited. This study aims to assess the safety and effectiveness of a conformal PFA balloon catheter for PVI in paroxysmal AF.Methods 35 patients with paroxysmal AF (PAF) were treated with a PFBalloon catheter (Biphasic, Bipolar, 750 V). The balloon was inflated with 10:1 saline/contrast, with volume adjusted for spherical wide-antral or pear-shaped ostial-junction PV ablation to ensure optimal tissue contact. The primary safety endpoint was absence of periprocedural primary adverse events. The primary effectiveness endpoint was acute PVI. The secondary effectiveness endpoint included durable PVI assessed by remapping at three months post-ablation and 1-year clinical outcomes.Results All targeted PVs (142/142) in 35 patients were acutely isolated, with 32.3 ± 4.5 applications per patient and 7.9 ± 1.0 per vein. Procedure and left atrial dwell times were 133 ± 46 and 56 ± 25 min, respectively. No hemolysis-related acute kidney injury or severe device-related complications occurred. PVI durability was 76.0% (19/25) per patient and 93.1% (95/102) per vein. After a median follow-up of 367 (interquartile range 357-380) days, 1-year Kaplan-Meier estimate for freedom from atrial arrhythmia (AF/atrial flutter/atrial tachycardia) ≥30 s was 90.7% (95% CI, 81.2%-100%).Conclusions The conformal PFBalloon catheter demonstrated favorable safety, efficiency, and effectiveness for PVI in PAF patients, achieving durable lesions and a high rate of freedom from atrial arrhythmias recurrence.Trial registration clinicaltrials.gov NCT07320976.

AI.tldr: 新型共形脉冲场消融球囊导管在阵发性房颤患者中实现100%急性肺静脉隔离，1年无房性心律失常复发率90.7%，安全性良好。
AI.motivation: 热球囊导管提高了房颤肺静脉隔离的效率，但关于脉冲场消融球囊导管用于PVI的安全性和有效性的报道有限。本研究旨在评估一种共形PFA球囊导管用于阵发性房颤PVI的安全性和有效性。
AI.method: 首次人体研究，纳入35例阵发性房颤患者，使用PFBalloon导管（双相双极，750 V）进行PVI。球囊充以10:1盐水/造影剂，根据肺静脉解剖调整容积以实现球形宽前庭或梨形开口-交界部消融。主要安全终点为围术期主要不良事件缺失；主要有效性终点为急性PVI；次要有效性终点包括术后3个月标测评估的持久PVI和1年临床结局。
AI.result: 所有靶向肺静脉（142/142）急性隔离成功，每患者平均消融32.3±4.5次，每静脉7.9±1.0次。手术时间和左房停留时间分别为133±46和56±25分钟。无溶血相关急性肾损伤或严重器械相关并发症。持久PVI患者水平为76.0%（19/25），静脉水平为93.1%（95/102）。中位随访367天（IQR 357-380），1年无房性心律失常（AF/房扑/房速）≥30秒的Kaplan-Meier估计为90.7%（95% CI 81.2%-100%）。
AI.conclusion: 共形PFBalloon导管在阵发性房颤患者PVI中表现出良好的安全性、效率和有效性，实现了持久病变和高无复发率。该首次人体经验支持进一步研究，但样本量小且缺乏对照，需更大规模试验验证。

summary_zh:
背景：热球囊导管提高了心房颤动（AF）中肺静脉隔离（PVI）的效率。评估脉冲场消融（PFA）球囊导管用于PVI的额外安全性和有效性的报告有限。本研究旨在评估一种适形PFA球囊导管用于阵发性AF中PVI的安全性和有效性。

方法：35例阵发性AF（PAF）患者接受PFBalloon导管（双相、双极、750 V）治疗。球囊以10:1生理盐水/造影剂充盈，并根据球形宽前庭或梨形开口-交界处PV消融调整体积，以确保最佳组织接触。主要安全性终点为无围术期主要不良事件。主要有效性终点为急性PVI。次要有效性终点包括消融后三个月通过再标测评估的持久PVI和1年临床结局。

结果：35例患者中所有靶向PV（142/142）均急性隔离，每例患者32.3 ± 4.5次应用，每根静脉7.9 ± 1.0次。手术时间和左心房停留时间分别为133 ± 46和56 ± 25分钟。未发生溶血相关急性肾损伤或严重器械相关并发症。PVI持久性为每例患者76.0%（19/25），每根静脉93.1%（95/102）。中位随访367（四分位距357-380）天后，1年无房性心律失常（AF/心房扑动/房性心动过速）≥30秒的Kaplan-Meier估计值为90.7%（95% CI，81.2%-100%）。

结论：适形PFBalloon导管在PAF患者PVI中表现出良好的安全性、效率和有效性，实现了持久病变和高比例的无房性心律失常复发。

试验注册：clinicaltrials.gov NCT07320976。

title: Cardiometabolic health-frailty phenotypes and bidirectional transitions between atrial fibrillation and heart failure: multistate trajectories and proteomic signatures
summary: Objective To examine whether a joint cardiometabolic health-frailty phenotype is associated with incident atrial fibrillation (AF), incident heart failure (HF) and progression to AF-HF comorbidity, and to identify candidate circulating protein signals related to this phenotype.Methods Among 319,048 UK Biobank participants without AF or HF, cardiometabolic status (healthy [CMH] or unhealthy [CMU]) and Frailty status (non-frail [NF] or pre-frail/frail [F]) defined four phenotypes. Cox and clock-forward multistate models estimated disease-specific and transition-specific hazards. Proteomic feature selection and exploratory mediation analyses included 28,206 participants with Olink plasma proteomic data.Results During follow-up, 17,844 participants developed AF, 5,410 developed HF, and 2,403 and 791 progressed from AF and HF, respectively, to comorbidity. Compared with CMH-NF, CMU-F was associated with the greatest risks of incident HF (hazard ratio (HR), 2.76; 95% confidence interval (CI), 2.59-2.95) and AF (HR, 1.49; 95% CI, 1.43-1.55). Corresponding multistate HRs were 2.98 (95% CI, 2.76-3.22) for baseline-to-HF, 1.45 (1.39-1.51) for baseline-to-AF, 1.76 (1.57-1.98) for AF-to-comorbidity, and 1.27 (1.02-1.57) for HF-to-comorbidity. Positive additive interactions indicated excess risk from coexisting cardiometabolic unhealthiness and frailty. Thirteen proteins showed statistical mediation signals for both outcomes; FABP4 yielded the largest positive mediated proportions (AF, 49.8%; HF, 32.9%) and transition-specific signals for baseline-to-AF and AF-to-comorbidity.Conclusions Coexisting cardiometabolic unhealthiness and frailty identified individuals at greatest risk of AF, HF, and subsequent comorbidity. Exploratory proteomic analyses identified FABP4 as the most consistent preliminary signal, which warrants further validation in independent cohorts.

AI.tldr: 在UK Biobank无AF/HF人群中，心血管代谢不健康合并衰弱（CMU-F）表型与AF、HF及AF-HF共病风险最高相关，FABP4是初步蛋白信号。
AI.motivation: 心血管代谢健康与衰弱常共存，但其联合表型是否影响AF、HF及其相互进展的风险尚不明确，且缺乏相关循环蛋白标志物证据。
AI.method: 基于UK Biobank 319,048名基线无AF/HF参与者，按心血管代谢健康（CMH/CMU）和衰弱（NF/F）定义四种表型。采用Cox和时钟前进多状态模型估计疾病特异及转移特异风险比。在28,206名有Olink血浆蛋白数据者中进行蛋白特征选择和探索性中介分析。
AI.result: 随访期间17,844人发生AF，5,410人发生HF，分别有2,403和791人从AF或HF进展为共病。与CMH-NF相比，CMU-F发生HF的HR为2.76（95%CI 2.59-2.95），AF为1.49（1.43-1.55）。多状态HR：基线至HF 2.98（2.76-3.22），基线至AF 1.45（1.39-1.51），AF至共病1.76（1.57-1.98），HF至共病1.27（1.02-1.57）。相加交互分析提示CMU与衰弱共存存在超额风险。13种蛋白对两种结局均有中介信号，FABP4中介比例最大（AF 49.8%，HF 32.9%），并在基线至AF及AF至共病转移中显示信号。
AI.conclusion: 心血管代谢不健康与衰弱共存可识别AF、HF及共病最高危人群，FABP4为最一致的初步蛋白信号，需独立队列验证；本研究为观察性设计，蛋白分析为探索性，不能推断因果。

summary_zh: 目的：探讨联合心脏代谢健康-衰弱表型是否与 incident atrial fibrillation (AF)、incident heart failure (HF) 以及进展为 AF-HF 共病相关，并识别与该表型相关的候选循环蛋白信号。方法：在 319,048 名无 AF 或 HF 的 UK Biobank 参与者中，心脏代谢状态（健康 [CMH] 或不健康 [CMU]）和衰弱状态（非衰弱 [NF] 或衰弱前期/衰弱 [F]）定义了四种表型。Cox 模型和 clock-forward 多状态模型估计了疾病特异性和转换特异性风险。蛋白质组学特征选择和探索性中介分析包括 28,206 名具有 Olink 血浆蛋白质组数据的参与者。结果：随访期间，17,844 名参与者发生 AF，5,410 名发生 HF，分别有 2,403 名和 791 名从 AF 和 HF 进展为共病。与 CMH-NF 相比，CMU-F 与 incident HF（风险比 (HR)，2.76；95% 置信区间 (CI)，2.59-2.95）和 AF（HR，1.49；95% CI，1.43-1.55）的最高风险相关。相应的多状态 HR 为：基线至 HF 2.98（95% CI，2.76-3.22），基线至 AF 1.45（1.39-1.51），AF 至共病 1.76（1.57-1.98），HF 至共病 1.27（1.02-1.57）。阳性加性交互作用表明心脏代谢不健康和衰弱共存导致超额风险。十三种蛋白质对两种结局均显示出统计学中介信号；FABP4 产生了最大的阳性中介比例（AF，49.8%；HF，32.9%）以及基线至 AF 和 AF 至共病的转换特异性信号。结论：心脏代谢不健康和衰弱共存识别出 AF、HF 及随后共病风险最高的个体。探索性蛋白质组学分析确定 FABP4 为最一致的初步信号，值得在独立队列中进一步验证。

title: Cardiometabolic Substrate Modification in Atrial Fibrillation: Obesity and Epicardial Adipose Tissue in the Era of Incretin-Based Therapies and Catheter Ablation
summary: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is increasingly understood as the electrical expression of a systemic and atrial cardiometabolic disease rather than an isolated disorder of pulmonary-vein triggers. Obesity, insulin resistance, hypertension, sleep-disordered breathing, heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, and visceral adiposity promote atrial stretch, inflammation, fibrosis, autonomic imbalance, and conduction heterogeneity. Epicardial adipose tissue (EAT), particularly the peri-left-atrial depot, may provide a local mechanistic bridge between systemic metabolic dysfunction and atrial cardiomyopathy through paracrine, inflammatory, fibrotic, and infiltrative pathways. This framework has direct therapeutic implications. Structured weight loss, cardiorespiratory fitness, alcohol reduction, and comprehensive risk-factor management can reduce AF burden and improve rhythm-control outcomes, although the magnitude of benefit varies across populations and trial designs. Incretin-based therapies have introduced a potentially important pharmacologic route to substrate modification. Semaglutide and tirzepatide produce substantial weight loss and favorable cardiovascular and heart-failure effects, while emerging observational and prospective data suggest lower AF incidence and post-ablation recurrence. However, evidence for reduced post-ablation recurrence remains predominantly non-randomized and is susceptible to residual confounding, treatment-selection effects, and healthy-user bias. Causality, weight-independent antiarrhythmic effects, optimal timing relative to ablation, and durability after treatment withdrawal remain unresolved. Observational sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitor data support further investigation of cardiometabolic approaches to rhythm control, although randomized evidence has not consistently demonstrated benefit. Our review integrates mechanistic, imaging, lifestyle, pharmacologic, and electrophysiological evidence and proposes a practical model in which catheter ablation and cardiometabolic substrate modification are complementary strategies.
journal: Journal of Cardiovascular Development and Disease

AI.tldr: 房颤是系统性心脏代谢疾病的心房表现，减重、运动及GLP-1受体激动剂等代谢干预可改善心律控制，但减少消融后复发的证据仍以非随机研究为主。
AI.motivation: 房颤传统上被视为肺静脉触发的孤立性电学疾病，但肥胖、胰岛素抵抗、心外膜脂肪等代谢因素通过心房牵张、炎症、纤维化等机制促进心房心肌病，既往证据多聚焦单一干预，缺乏系统整合代谢基质修饰与导管消融的框架。
AI.method: 本文为叙述性综述，整合机制、影像、生活方式、药物及电生理证据，提出导管消融与心脏代谢基质修饰互补的实践模型；摘要未报告系统检索策略、纳入研究数量或定量合成方法。
AI.result: 结构化减重、心肺适能、限酒及综合危险因素管理可降低房颤负荷并改善心律控制结局，但获益幅度因人群和试验设计而异；司美格鲁肽和替尔泊肽带来显著减重及心血管/心衰获益，观察性和前瞻性数据提示可降低房颤发生率及消融后复发，但减少复发证据主要为非随机研究，易受残余混杂、治疗选择效应和健康使用者偏倚影响；SGLT2抑制剂观察性数据支持进一步研究，但随机证据未一致显示获益。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%CI或P值。
AI.conclusion: 房颤管理应超越单纯肺静脉隔离，将心脏代谢基质修饰与导管消融作为互补策略；但胰高血糖素样肽-1（GLP-1）类药物减少消融后复发的因果性、体重非依赖性抗心律失常效应、最佳时机及停药后持久性尚未解决，需随机对照试验验证。

summary_zh: 心房颤动（AF）日益被理解为一种全身性和心房心肌代谢性疾病在电学上的表现，而非孤立的肺静脉触发灶疾病。肥胖、胰岛素抵抗、高血压、睡眠呼吸障碍、射血分数保留的心力衰竭以及内脏脂肪堆积可促进心房牵张、炎症、纤维化、自主神经失衡和传导异质性。心外膜脂肪组织（EAT），尤其是左心房周围脂肪库，可能通过旁分泌、炎症、纤维化和浸润途径，在全身代谢功能障碍与心房心肌病之间提供局部机制性桥梁。这一框架具有直接的治疗意义。结构化减重、心肺适能、减少酒精摄入和全面的危险因素管理可减少AF负荷并改善节律控制结局，尽管获益幅度因人群和试验设计而异。基于肠促胰素的疗法为基质改良引入了一种可能重要的药理学途径。司美格鲁肽和替尔泊肽可产生显著减重以及有利的心血管和心力衰竭效应，而新兴的观察性和前瞻性数据提示AF发病率降低和消融后复发减少。然而，关于减少消融后复发的证据仍主要为非随机证据，且易受残余混杂、治疗选择效应和健康使用者偏倚的影响。因果关系、不依赖体重的抗心律失常效应、相对于消融的最佳时机以及治疗撤除后的持久性仍未解决。观察性钠-葡萄糖协同转运蛋白2（SGLT2）抑制剂数据支持对心脏代谢途径用于节律控制的进一步研究，尽管随机证据尚未一致证明获益。我们的综述整合了机制、影像、生活方式、药理学和电生理学证据，并提出了一种实用模型，其中导管消融和心脏代谢基质改良是互补策略。

title: Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion vs Oral Anticoagulation for Stroke Prevention in Atrial Fibrillation: A Meta-Analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Left atrial appendage occlusion (LAAO) has emerged as a non-pharmacological alternative to oral anticoagulation (OAC) for stroke prevention in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF). Following the publication of recent CHAMPION-AF and CLOSURE-AF trials, an updated synthesis of evidence is warranted to clarify the long-term comparative efficacy and safety of LAAO versus OAC in patients with AF.

METHODS: We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) comparing LAAO with OAC in adults with AF. A comprehensive search of major databases was performed from inception to April 2026. The primary efficacy outcomes were major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) and stroke. The primary safety outcome was non-procedure-related bleeding. Random-effects models were used to calculate pooled risk ratios (RRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs).

RESULTS: Six RCTs including 7,004 patients (3,681 LAAO; 3,323 OAC) were analyzed. No statistically significant difference was observed for MACE (7.5% vs 6.9%; RR 1.03, 95% CI 0.79-1.34) or stroke (3.7% vs 3.2%; RR 1.07, 95% CI 0.80-1.43). LAAO was associated with a significantly lower risk of non-procedure-related bleeding (9.8% vs 16.7%; RR 0.63, 95% CI 0.52-0.77), corresponding to an absolute risk reduction of 6.9% and an approximate number needed to treat of 15 based on crude pooled event rates over the observed trial follow-up. Trial sequential analysis indicated that the accumulated evidence for MACE and stroke remained inconclusive. Comparator-type subgroup analyses showed no significant interaction for MACE (p = 0.67) or stroke (p = 0.81) between contemporary predominantly-DOAC and VKA comparator trials.

CONCLUSIONS: LAAO was associated with lower non-procedure-related bleeding, while no statistically significant differences were observed for MACE or stroke. The available efficacy evidence remains inconclusive regarding equivalence or non-inferiority, and larger trials are needed. These findings support individualized consideration of LAAO when the long-term bleeding burden of anticoagulation is clinically important.

AI.tldr: 在房颤患者中，左心耳封堵（LAAO）与口服抗凝（OAC）相比，非手术相关出血风险显著更低，但主要不良心血管事件（MACE）和卒中风险无统计学差异。
AI.motivation: LAAO作为非药物性卒中预防手段，其与OAC的长期疗效和安全性对比尚不明确，尤其是近期CHAMPION-AF和CLOSURE-AF试验发表后，需要更新证据合成。
AI.method: 系统综述与荟萃分析，纳入6项随机对照试验（RCT），共7,004例房颤患者（LAAO 3,681例，OAC 3,323例）。主要疗效终点为MACE和卒中，主要安全终点为非手术相关出血。采用随机效应模型计算合并风险比（RR）及95%置信区间（CI），并进行试验序贯分析和亚组分析。
AI.result: LAAO组与OAC组相比，MACE发生率无显著差异（7.5% vs 6.9%；RR 1.03，95% CI 0.79-1.34），卒中发生率亦无显著差异（3.7% vs 3.2%；RR 1.07，95% CI 0.80-1.43）。LAAO组非手术相关出血风险显著降低（9.8% vs 16.7%；RR 0.63，95% CI 0.52-0.77），绝对风险降低6.9%，需治疗人数（NNT）约为15。试验序贯分析提示MACE和卒中的累积证据尚不明确。亚组分析显示，在当代以DOAC为主的对照试验与VKA对照试验之间，MACE（交互作用p=0.67）和卒中（交互作用p=0.81）均无显著交互作用。
AI.conclusion: LAAO与非手术相关出血风险降低相关，但MACE和卒中方面与OAC无显著差异，现有疗效证据尚不足以确定等效性或非劣效性，需要更大规模试验。当长期抗凝出血负担具有重要临床意义时，这些发现支持个体化考虑LAAO。

summary_zh:
背景：左心耳封堵（LAAO）已成为口服抗凝（OAC）的非药物替代方案，用于心房颤动（AF）患者的卒中预防。随着近期 CHAMPION-AF 和 CLOSURE-AF 试验的发表，有必要对证据进行更新综合，以阐明 LAAO 与 OAC 在 AF 患者中的长期比较疗效和安全性。

方法：我们对比较 LAAO 与 OAC 在成人 AF 患者中应用的随机对照试验（RCT）进行了系统综述和荟萃分析。对主要数据库进行了从建库至 2026 年 4 月的全面检索。主要疗效结局为主要不良心血管事件（MACE）和卒中。主要安全性结局为非手术相关出血。采用随机效应模型计算合并风险比（RR）及其 95% 置信区间（CI）。

结果：共纳入 6 项 RCT，包括 7,004 例患者（3,681 例 LAAO；3,323 例 OAC）。MACE（7.5% vs 6.9%；RR 1.03，95% CI 0.79-1.34）或卒中（3.7% vs 3.2%；RR 1.07，95% CI 0.80-1.43）均未观察到统计学显著差异。LAAO 与非手术相关出血风险显著降低相关（9.8% vs 16.7%；RR 0.63，95% CI 0.52-0.77），对应于绝对风险降低 6.9%，基于观察期间试验随访的粗合并事件率，需治疗人数约为 15。试验序贯分析表明，MACE 和卒中的累积证据仍不明确。比较类型亚组分析显示，当代以 DOAC 为主与 VKA 对照试验之间，MACE（p = 0.67）或卒中（p = 0.81）均无显著交互作用。

结论：LAAO 与非手术相关出血降低相关，而 MACE 或卒中未观察到统计学显著差异。现有疗效证据在等效性或非劣效性方面仍不明确，需要更大规模的试验。这些发现支持在抗凝长期出血负担具有临床重要性时，对 LAAO 进行个体化考虑。

title: Atrial Fibrillation and Aging: The Role of MicroRNA Networks Across Cellular, Structural, and Electrophysiological Remodeling
summary: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most common sustained cardiac arrhythmia, affecting millions worldwide with an incidence that rises with age, and it carries a substantially increased risk of ischemic stroke, heart failure, and cognitive decline. Aging is its most important independent risk factor, yet biological rather than chronological age progressively alters the atrial substrate through interactions among cellular and tissue processes that increase susceptibility. Although the mechanisms linking biological aging to AF remain incompletely elucidated, microRNAs (miRNAs) have been implicated. Human studies show age-associated changes in atrial conduction, molecular regulation, and miRNA expression, while experimental models identify modifiable pathways contributing to structural or electrophysiological vulnerability. Within this architecture, miRNAs emerge as context-dependent regulatory and intercellular signaling nodes. Here we identify the missing-edge problem as a central limitation of the field, distinguishing mechanistic evidence from circulating-miRNA biomarker associations, and experimental targetability from clinical efficacy. We propose a model of networked atrial aging in which heterogeneous age-associated cellular states converge on structural and electrophysiological vulnerability. Further studies connecting aging state, miRNA targets, atrial phenotype, and AF within one biological framework are needed to establish causal pathways and enable biomarker and therapeutic translation.

AI.tldr: 衰老通过miRNA网络调控心房细胞、结构和电生理重构，促进房颤发生，但现有证据存在机制与关联、实验与临床间的缺失环节。
AI.motivation: 房颤是最常见的持续性心律失常，衰老是其最重要的独立危险因素，但生物学衰老而非时间年龄如何改变心房基质以增加房颤易感性尚不完全清楚。既往研究提示miRNA参与其中，但机制证据与循环miRNA生物标志物关联、实验可靶向性与临床疗效之间存在缺口，即“缺失边问题”。
AI.method: 本文为综述，综合人类研究和实验模型证据，探讨衰老相关心房传导、分子调控和miRNA表达变化，区分机制证据与循环miRNA生物标志物关联，以及实验靶向性与临床疗效，并提出网络化心房衰老模型。摘要未报告系统检索策略、纳入研究数量或定量合成方法。
AI.result: 人类研究显示衰老伴随心房传导、分子调控和miRNA表达的改变；实验模型识别出可改变的通路，这些通路导致结构或电生理脆弱性。miRNA作为背景依赖的调控和细胞间信号节点发挥作用。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 衰老相关异质性细胞状态汇聚于结构和电生理脆弱性，miRNA网络是潜在调控节点。未来需在同一生物学框架内连接衰老状态、miRNA靶点、心房表型和房颤，以确立因果通路并推动生物标志物和治疗转化。当前证据多为关联性，机制与临床转化间存在缺失环节，需进一步研究验证。

summary_zh: 心房颤动（AF）是最常见的持续性心律失常，影响全球数百万人，其发病率随年龄增长而上升，并显著增加缺血性卒中、心力衰竭和认知功能下降的风险。衰老是其最重要的独立危险因素，然而生物学年龄而非时序年龄通过细胞和组织过程之间的相互作用逐步改变心房基质，从而增加易感性。尽管将生物学衰老与AF联系起来的机制仍未完全阐明，但microRNA（miRNA）已被认为参与其中。人类研究显示心房传导、分子调控和miRNA表达随年龄相关变化，而实验模型则确定了导致结构或电生理易感性的可改变通路。在这一架构中，miRNA作为情境依赖的调控和细胞间信号节点出现。在此，我们将缺失边问题确定为该领域的核心局限，区分机制证据与循环miRNA生物标志物关联，以及实验可靶向性与临床疗效。我们提出一个网络化心房衰老模型，其中异质性年龄相关细胞状态汇聚于结构和电生理易感性。需要进一步研究在一个生物学框架内连接衰老状态、miRNA靶点、心房表型和AF，以建立因果通路并实现生物标志物和治疗转化。

title: The prognostic value of interleukin-6 in the assessment of arrhythmia recurrence in patients with hypertension and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
summary: Aim. To study the prognostic value of interleukin-6 (IL-6) in assessing the risk of arrhythmia recurrence in patients with arterial hypertension (AH) and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (AF). Materials and methods. 95 patients with AH and paroxysmal AF were included in the study. The prospective follow-up of the patients was 6 months, and the end point of the study was a reported recurrence of AF. Depending on the end point of the study, the patients were divided into 2 groups: group 1 included 32 patients who had a recurrence of AF within 6 months; group 2 consisted of 63 patients without recurrence of arrhythmia. Results. The average concentration of IL-6 in blood plasma at the inclusion visit was significantly higher in patients of group 1 than in patients of group 2 (p0.05). There was a significant increase in the Cardio-Ankle Vascular Index (CAVI index) in patients with AF relapses than in patients without AF relapses – 8.9 [8.6; 9.1] and 7.7 [7.5; 8.3] (p0.05). We found a moderate direct correlation between the value of the CAVI index and the plasma concentration of IL-6 (r=0.6; p=0.024). In patients with AH and paroxysmal AF, a statistically significant association with the likelihood of arrhythmia recurrence was shown by such indicators as the level of IL-6 in blood plasma (Odds Ratio 1.42, 95% Confidence Interval – CI 1.18–1.70; p=0.001) and the CAVI index (Odds Ratio 1.31, 95% CI 1.08–1.58; p=0.005). Conclusion. An increase in the level of IL-6 in blood plasma of more than 4.0 pg/ml with a sensitivity of 70% and specificity of 72% indicates a high risk of AF recurrence in patients with AH and paroxysmal AF (Area Under the Curve – AUC 0.76), increases the risk of recurrence of arrhythmia by 1.42 times (95% CI 1.18–1.70; p=0.001).

AI.tldr: 在高血压合并阵发性房颤患者中，血浆IL-6>4.0 pg/ml可预测6个月内房颤复发，敏感性70%、特异性72%，AUC 0.76，复发风险增加1.42倍。
AI.motivation: 高血压合并阵发性房颤患者消融或药物节律控制后复发风险高，亟需可常规检测的炎症标志物指导风险分层；IL-6与房颤复发的关系此前证据有限。
AI.method: 前瞻性队列研究，纳入95例高血压合并阵发性房颤患者，随访6个月，终点为房颤复发；按是否复发分为复发组32例与未复发组63例，比较基线血浆IL-6、心踝血管指数（CAVI）并作相关与logistic回归分析。
AI.conclusion: IL-6>4.0 pg/ml提示高血压合并阵发性房颤患者房颤复发高风险，可将IL-6纳入复发风险分层；但样本量小、随访仅6个月、单中心，结论需更大样本验证。

summary_zh:
目的：研究白细胞介素-6（IL-6）在评估动脉高血压（AH）合并阵发性心房颤动（AF）患者心律失常复发风险中的预后价值。

材料与方法：研究纳入95例AH合并阵发性AF患者。对患者进行为期6个月的前瞻性随访，研究终点为报告的AF复发。根据研究终点，患者分为2组：第1组包括32例在6个月内AF复发的患者；第2组由63例无心律失常复发的患者组成。

结果：入选访视时，第1组患者血浆IL-6平均浓度显著高于第2组患者（p<0.05）。AF复发患者的心踝血管指数（CAVI指数）显著高于无AF复发患者——分别为8.9 [8.6; 9.1]和7.7 [7.5; 8.3]（p<0.05）。我们发现CAVI指数值与血浆IL-6浓度之间存在中度正相关（r=0.6；p=0.024）。在AH合并阵发性AF患者中，血浆IL-6水平（比值比1.42，95%置信区间–CI 1.18–1.70；p=0.001）和CAVI指数（比值比1.31，95% CI 1.08–1.58；p=0.005）等指标显示与心律失常复发的可能性有统计学显著关联。

结论：血浆IL-6水平升高超过4.0 pg/ml，敏感性70%、特异性72%，表明AH合并阵发性AF患者AF复发风险高（曲线下面积–AUC 0.76），使心律失常复发风险增加1.42倍（95% CI 1.18–1.70；p=0.001）。

title: Transient Type 1 Brugada ECG Pattern in a Patient With Severe Coronary Artery Disease
summary: A type 1 Brugada electrocardiographic (ECG) pattern is characteristic of Brugada syndrome but may also occur in association with reversible clinical conditions, including myocardial ischaemia.We describe a 49year-old man with type 2 diabetes mellitus, severe hypercholesterolaemia and a strong family history of premature ischaemic heart disease who presented with crescendo angina.His admission ECG demonstrated a type 1 Brugada pattern, with subsequent ECGs showing dynamic anterior ischaemic changes.Coronary angiography demonstrated extensive multivessel coronary artery disease, and the patient underwent urgent surgical revascularisation following Heart Team discussion.Serial postoperative ECGs demonstrated complete resolution of the type 1 pattern despite continuation of his regular medication, including mirtazapine.In the absence of arrhythmic syncope, documented ventricular arrhythmia, previous cardiac arrest or a family history of sudden cardiac death, sodium-channel blocker provocation testing was not pursued.Although latent Brugada syndrome cannot be definitively excluded, the temporal relationship between myocardial ischaemia, revascularisation and ECG normalisation supports an ischaemia-associated Brugada phenotype.

AI.tldr: 一例49岁严重多支冠脉病变患者在心绞痛发作期间出现1型Brugada心电图模式，血运重建后该模式完全消失，提示心肌缺血可诱发可逆性Brugada表型。
AI.motivation: 1型Brugada心电图模式是Brugada综合征的特征性表现，但也可与心肌缺血等可逆性临床情况相关。既往证据提示心肌缺血可能诱发Brugada样心电图改变，但缺血与Brugada表型之间的因果关系及临床管理策略尚需进一步明确。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。患者为49岁男性，有2型糖尿病、严重高胆固醇血症及早发缺血性心脏病家族史，因进行性加重的心绞痛就诊。入院心电图显示1型Brugada模式，后续心电图出现动态前壁缺血性改变。冠状动脉造影显示广泛多支冠状动脉病变，经心脏团队讨论后行紧急外科血运重建。术后系列心电图随访观察Brugada模式变化。未行钠通道阻滞剂激发试验。
AI.result: 冠状动脉造影证实广泛多支冠状动脉病变。患者接受紧急外科血运重建后，术后系列心电图显示1型Brugada模式完全消失，且患者继续服用包括米氮平在内的常规药物。摘要未报告具体心电图参数、冠状动脉病变细节及统计学比较。
AI.conclusion: 心肌缺血、血运重建与心电图正常化之间的时间关系支持缺血相关的Brugada表型。对于严重冠状动脉病变患者出现1型Brugada心电图模式，应评估可逆性缺血因素；血运重建后Brugada模式可完全消失。但潜在Brugada综合征不能完全排除，需结合临床及随访进一步评估。

summary_zh: 1型Brugada心电图（ECG）模式是Brugada综合征的特征性表现，但也可能伴随可逆的临床状况出现，包括心肌缺血。我们描述了一位49岁男性，患有2型糖尿病、严重高胆固醇血症以及早发缺血性心脏病的强烈家族史，因渐增性心绞痛就诊。入院心电图显示1型Brugada模式，随后的心电图显示动态前壁缺血性改变。冠状动脉造影显示广泛的冠状动脉多支病变，经过心脏团队讨论后，患者接受了紧急外科血运重建。术后连续心电图显示1型模式完全消失，尽管继续服用包括米氮平在内的常规药物。由于没有心律失常性晕厥、记录到的室性心律失常、既往心脏骤停或心源性猝死家族史，未进行钠通道阻滞剂激发试验。虽然不能明确排除潜在Brugada综合征，但心肌缺血、血运重建和心电图正常化之间的时间关系支持缺血相关的Brugada表型。

title: Supplemental Material for: Clinical Outcomes of Anomalous Aortic Origin of Right Coronary Artery from the Left Coronary Sinus
summary: Introduction: Anomalous Aortic Origin of Right Coronary Artery (AAORCA) is a rare congenital anomaly that may be associated with adverse cardiac events, including sudden cardiac death. Surgical correction is commonly recommended in patients with AAORCA. Coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) is a prevalent diagnostic modality, which increases AAORCA detection. However, the clinical significance of incidentally detected AAORCA remains unclear.Methods: This non-randomized retrospective analysis included 10,134 patients who underwent CCTA between January 2014 and December 2022, either for suspected coronary artery disease (CAD) or a medical check-up. Three groups were created: patients with normal coronary anatomy (normal), with AAORCA (anomaly), and CAD without AAORCA (CAD). CAD was defined as a percentage diameter stenosis of ≥50% in one or more segments. Cardiac mortality was this study’s primary endpoint.Results: Normal, anomaly, and CAD group comprised 7592 (74.9%), 66 (0.7%), and 2476 (24.4%) patients, respectively. During a median follow-up of 33.7 months (IQR: 13.2–53.4), Kaplan-Meier analysis revealed no significant difference in the cardiac death occurrence between the normal (15 events, 0.2%) and anomaly groups (0 events, 0%) (log-rank p=0.685). Cox proportional hazards model revealed no difference in mortality in the anomaly group compared with normal group.Conclusions: In our cohort, incidentally detected AAORCA in adults did not demonstrate a clearly elevated cardiac death risk relative to CAD during mid-term follow-up. However, given the small number of events, these findings should be interpreted as descriptive rather than confirmatory evidence of a benign natural course, particularly in populations at higher risk of exertional sudden cardiac death.

AI.tldr: 在10134例接受CCTA的患者中，偶发发现的右冠状动脉异常起源于左冠状窦（AAORCA）未显示心脏死亡风险显著高于正常或CAD人群，但事件数少需谨慎解读。
AI.motivation: AAORCA是一种罕见的先天性冠状动脉异常，可能与包括心源性猝死在内的心脏不良事件相关，常建议手术矫正。随着CCTA的普及，AAORCA的检出率增加，但偶发发现的AAORCA的临床意义尚不明确，缺乏长期随访证据。
AI.method: 非随机回顾性分析，纳入2014年1月至2022年12月期间因疑似冠心病或体检接受CCTA的10134例患者，分为正常冠脉解剖组（normal）、AAORCA组（anomaly）和无AAORCA的冠心病组（CAD）。CAD定义为至少一个节段直径狭窄≥50%。主要终点为心源性死亡。采用Kaplan-Meier分析和Cox比例风险模型进行统计。
AI.result: 正常组7592例（74.9%），AAORCA组66例（0.7%），CAD组2476例（24.4%）。中位随访33.7个月（IQR 13.2–53.4），Kaplan-Meier分析显示正常组与AAORCA组的心源性死亡发生率无显著差异（正常组15例事件，0.2%；AAORCA组0例事件，0%；log-rank p=0.685）。Cox比例风险模型显示AAORCA组与正常组相比死亡率无差异。
AI.conclusion: 在本队列中，成人偶发发现的AAORCA在中期的随访中未显示相对于CAD明显升高的心源性死亡风险。然而，由于事件数少，这些发现应被视为描述性而非确证性证据，不能证明其良性自然病程，尤其是在运动性猝死高风险人群中。对电生理实践的影响有限，但提示对偶发AAORCA患者需个体化评估，不宜一概推荐手术。

summary_zh:
引言：右冠状动脉异常起源于主动脉（AAORCA）是一种罕见的先天性异常，可能与不良心脏事件相关，包括心源性猝死。对于AAORCA患者，通常建议进行手术矫正。冠状动脉计算机断层扫描血管造影（CCTA）是一种常用的诊断方法，可提高AAORCA的检出率。然而，偶然发现的AAORCA的临床意义尚不清楚。

方法：这项非随机回顾性分析纳入了2014年1月至2022年12月期间接受CCTA的10,134例患者，这些患者或因疑似冠状动脉疾病（CAD）或进行体检而接受检查。研究分为三组：冠状动脉解剖正常的患者（正常组）、AAORCA患者（异常组）以及无AAORCA的CAD患者（CAD组）。CAD定义为在一个或多个节段中直径狭窄百分比≥50%。心脏死亡率是本研究的主要终点。

结果：正常组、异常组和CAD组分别包括7592例（74.9%）、66例（0.7%）和2476例（24.4%）患者。在中位随访33.7个月（IQR：13.2–53.4）期间，Kaplan-Meier分析显示正常组（15例事件，0.2%）与异常组（0例事件，0%）之间的心脏死亡发生率无显著差异（log-rank p=0.685）。Cox比例风险模型显示，与正常组相比，异常组的死亡率无差异。

结论：在我们的队列中，中短期随访期间，偶然发现的成人AAORCA相对于CAD并未显示出明显升高的心脏死亡风险。然而，鉴于事件数量较少，这些发现应被解释为描述性而非证实性证据，表明其良性自然病程，尤其是在运动性心源性猝死风险较高的人群中。

title: Rising Obesity-Driven Cardiac Mortality Among Young Adults in the United States: A 25-Year Retrospective Analysis (1999-2023)
summary: Background Obesity is a growing risk factor for cardiovascular disease and mortality in the United States, particularly among younger adults.Methods Using the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention Wide-Ranging Online Data for Epidemiologic Research Multiple Cause of Death database, we retrospectively analyzed trends and disparities in obesity-related cardiac mortality among US individuals aged 15 to 44 years from 1999 to 2023, stratified by sex, race, urbanization, and census region. Deaths were identified using International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision (ICD-10) codes for obesity and cardiac conditions, including ischemic heart disease, sudden cardiac death, arrhythmias, and heart failure. Age-adjusted mortality rates were calculated using joinpoint regression and expressed as annual percentage change with 95% CIs.Results Between 1999 and 2023, 51 860 obesity-related cardiac deaths were recorded. The age-adjusted mortality rates increased from 0.9 (95% CI, 0.8-0.9) to 2.5 (95% CI, 2.4-2.6) per 100 000. Mortality was highest during the COVID-19 pandemic (2019-2021). Men consistently had higher age-adjusted mortality rates than women. Black or African American and American Indian/Alaska Native individuals showed the highest racial disparities. The South and nonmetropolitan areas had the highest regional mortality, with Alaska recording the highest state-level age-adjusted mortality rate in 2023 (6.0 per 100 000). Mortality largely returned to baseline across most groups from 2021 to 2023.Conclusions Obesity-related cardiac mortality has risen in the United States over the past 2 decades with notable disparities across sex, race, region, and urbanization. These findings underscore the need for targeted public health interventions in high-risk populations to reduce premature cardiovascular deaths and reverse this trend.

AI.tldr: 1999-2023年美国15-44岁人群肥胖相关心脏死亡率从0.9升至2.5/10万，男性、黑人、美洲原住民及南部非都市区差异显著。
AI.motivation: 肥胖是美国心血管疾病和死亡的重要危险因素，但年轻成人肥胖相关心脏死亡的趋势和差异尚缺乏长期全国性数据。
AI.method: 基于CDC WONDER多死因数据库的回顾性分析，纳入1999-2023年美国15-44岁人群，以ICD-10编码识别肥胖相关心脏死亡（包括缺血性心脏病、心脏性猝死、心律失常和心力衰竭），按性别、种族、城乡和普查区域分层，采用joinpoint回归计算年龄调整死亡率及年度百分比变化（95%CI）。
AI.result: 共记录51 860例肥胖相关心脏死亡，年龄调整死亡率从0.9（95%CI 0.8-0.9）升至2.5（95%CI 2.4-2.6）/10万；COVID-19大流行期间（2019-2021）死亡率最高；男性始终高于女性；黑人或非裔美国人及美洲印第安人/阿拉斯加原住民种族差异最大；南部和非都市区死亡率最高，2023年阿拉斯加州年龄调整死亡率最高（6.0/10万）；2021-2023年大多数群体死亡率基本回落至基线。
AI.conclusion: 过去二十年美国年轻成人肥胖相关心脏死亡率上升，且存在显著的性别、种族、地区和城乡差异，提示需在高风险人群中开展针对性公共卫生干预以减少过早心血管死亡，但本研究为回顾性死亡证明分析，存在编码依赖和混杂因素局限。

summary_zh: 背景：肥胖是美国心血管疾病和死亡的一个日益增长的风险因素，尤其是在年轻成人中。方法：利用美国疾病控制与预防中心的流行病学研究广泛在线数据多重死因数据库，我们回顾性分析了1999年至2023年美国15至44岁个体中肥胖相关心脏死亡的趋势和差异，按性别、种族、城市化和人口普查区域分层。死亡使用国际疾病分类第十版（ICD-10）中肥胖和心脏疾病的代码进行识别，包括缺血性心脏病、心脏性猝死、心律失常和心力衰竭。年龄调整死亡率使用连接点回归计算，并以年度百分比变化及95% CI表示。结果：1999年至2023年间，记录了51 860例肥胖相关心脏死亡。年龄调整死亡率从每10万人0.9（95% CI，0.8-0.9）上升至2.5（95% CI，2.4-2.6）。COVID-19大流行期间（2019-2021年）死亡率最高。男性的年龄调整死亡率始终高于女性。黑人或非裔美国人以及美洲印第安人/阿拉斯加原住民的种族差异最大。南部和非大都市地区的区域死亡率最高，阿拉斯加州在2023年记录了最高的州级年龄调整死亡率（每10万人6.0）。2021年至2023年，大多数群体的死亡率基本恢复至基线水平。结论：过去20年，美国肥胖相关心脏死亡率上升，在性别、种族、地区和城市化方面存在显著差异。这些发现强调需要在高风险人群中采取有针对性的公共卫生干预措施，以减少过早心血管死亡并扭转这一趋势。

title: Stellate ganglion block for ventricular arrhythmia disease states: Emerging treatment options
summary: Autonomic modulation has emerged as an effective therapeutic target in the management of ventricular arrhythmias and electrical storm (e.g., refractory ventricular arrhythmias), in a background of growing evidence of the link between the autonomic nervous system and arrhythmias. Stellate ganglion blockade (SGB) is a minimally invasive procedure targeting the stellate ganglion with an anesthetic agent that has emerged as a temporizing treatment option for management of refractory and hemodynamically unstable ventricular arrhythmias and electrical storm (ES). SGB which can be performed with fluoroscopy-guidance or at the bedside with anatomic landmark approach or ultrasound guidance, has shown potential efficacy in short-term reduction of arrhythmic burden and termination of electrical storm, based on data from case series and observational studies. In the current review, we highlight the role of the autonomic nervous system in arrhythmogenesis and the clinical applications as well as current limitations and future directions of SGB in management of ventricular arrhythmia and electrical storm.

title: Management and Prognosis of Sustained Ventricular Tachycardia in the Emergency Department: A Retrospective, Observational, Single-Centre Study
summary: Background/Objectives: Sustained ventricular tachycardia (VT) is a potentially life-threatening arrhythmia requiring prompt Emergency Department (ED) assessment and management. However, data on its frequency, real-world treatment, and prognosis in the ED remain limited. We aimed to describe the clinical characteristics, acute management, and short- and long-term outcomes of patients presenting with VT. Methods: We retrospectively included consecutive patients presenting to the ED between January 2018 and December 2024 with a primary diagnosis of sustained VT with a pulse. We collected baseline characteristics, hemodynamic status, underlying cardiac disease, and acute treatment. In-hospital events and 30-day and 1-year outcomes were assessed. Results: A total of 103 patients were identified, accounting for approximately 0.025% of all ED visits during the study period; 84.5% were male. Chest pain (31.1%) and palpitations (25.2%) were the most common presenting symptoms. Structural heart disease was present in 90% of the cases, predominantly of ischemic origin (61%). Nearly half of the patients (49.5%) had a prior history of VT. Electrical cardioversion was performed in 28.2% of the cases. The majority of the patients (95/103; 92%) required hospitalization. Mortality was 4.9% at 30 days and 17% at 1 year. After adjustment for age, a left ventricular ejection fraction ≤ 30% and in-hospital arrhythmic recurrence were independently associated with 1-year mortality. Conclusions: Sustained VT is an uncommon but high-risk ED presentation, mainly affecting patients with ischemic structural heart disease. A discrepancy was observed between real-world clinical practice and guideline recommendations. The substantial mortality observed, particularly among patients with impaired left ventricular function or in-hospital arrhythmic recurrence, highlights the need for prompt risk stratification and optimized, guideline-concordant acute management.

AI.tldr: 急诊持续性室速虽仅占就诊量0.025%，但90%合并结构性心脏病，1年死亡率达17%，LVEF≤30%及院内复发独立预测死亡。
AI.motivation: 持续性室速是急诊危及生命的心律失常，需快速评估处理，但急诊环境下其发生率、真实世界治疗及预后数据有限，尤其缺乏短期与长期结局的报道。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性观察研究，纳入2018年1月至2024年12月急诊连续就诊、主要诊断为有脉持续性室速的成人患者，收集基线特征、血流动力学状态、基础心脏病及急性治疗，评估院内事件及30天、1年结局，采用多因素回归分析1年死亡预测因素。
AI.result: 共纳入103例，占同期急诊就诊量约0.025%，男性84.5%；最常见症状为胸痛（31.1%）和心悸（25.2%）；90%存在结构性心脏病，以缺血性为主（61%）；49.5%有室速病史；28.2%接受电复律；92%需住院。30天死亡率为4.9%，1年死亡率为17%。校正年龄后，LVEF≤30%和院内心律失常复发与1年死亡率独立相关。
AI.conclusion: 急诊持续性室速虽不常见但风险高，主要累及缺血性结构性心脏病患者，真实世界实践与指南推荐存在差距。LVEF严重减低或院内复发者死亡率高，提示需及时风险分层并优化指南一致的急性管理；但本研究为单中心回顾性设计，样本量有限，结论需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh: 背景/目的：持续性室性心动过速（VT）是一种可能危及生命的心律失常，需要急诊科（ED）及时评估和处理。然而，关于其在急诊科的发生频率、真实世界治疗和预后的数据仍然有限。我们旨在描述就诊于急诊科的VT患者的临床特征、急性期管理以及短期和长期结局。方法：我们回顾性连续纳入2018年1月至2024年12月期间就诊于急诊科、主要诊断为伴有脉搏的持续性VT的患者。我们收集了基线特征、血流动力学状态、基础心脏病和急性期治疗。评估了院内事件以及30天和1年结局。结果：共识别出103例患者，约占研究期间所有急诊就诊的0.025%；84.5%为男性。胸痛（31.1%）和心悸（25.2%）是最常见的就诊症状。90%的病例存在结构性心脏病，主要为缺血性病因（61%）。近半数患者（49.5%）有VT病史。28.2%的病例进行了电复律。大多数患者（95/103；92%）需要住院治疗。30天死亡率为4.9%，1年死亡率为17%。调整年龄后，左心室射血分数≤30%和院内心律失常复发与1年死亡率独立相关。结论：持续性VT是一种不常见但高风险的急诊就诊原因，主要影响缺血性结构性心脏病患者。观察到真实世界临床实践与指南推荐之间存在差异。观察到的显著死亡率，尤其是在左心室功能受损或院内心律失常复发的患者中，凸显了及时风险分层和优化、符合指南的急性期管理的必要性。

title: Reflex Supraventricular Tachycardia and Chest Pain Following the First Dose of Fixed-Dose Perindopril/Amlodipine in an Older Patient with Hypertension and Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: A Case Report
summary: Background: Fixed-dose combinations (FDCs) of an angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitor and a dihydropyridine calcium-channel blocker (CCB) are recommended as initial therapy for most patients with arterial hypertension and are generally well tolerated. Reflex tachycardia has not previously been reported with the perindopril/amlodipine combination. Case Presentation: A 70-year-old Caucasian man with arterial hypertension and type 2 diabetes mellitus developed chest pain 1 hour after the first dose of AlmirinComb 4/5 mg (perindopril 4 mg/amlodipine 5 mg). The prehospital ECG showed supraventricular tachycardia (SVT), which was terminated with adenosine (6 mg, then 12 mg); conversion to sinus rhythm was accompanied by transient inferior ST denivelation, and the chest pain resolved immediately. On arrival at the hospital, he was pain-free, haemodynamically stable (blood pressure 162/90 mmHg, heart rate 82 beats/min), and in normal sinus rhythm without ST-segment changes; serial high-sensitivity troponin I values remained within the normal range. Cardiology consultation attributed the event to reflex tachycardia. According to the World Health Organization-Uppsala Monitoring Centre (WHO-UMC) causality assessment system, the reaction was classified as probable. He was discharged on nebivolol with scheduled ambulatory follow-up (Holter-ECG, exercise testing, and echocardiography). Conclusion: This case suggests that a first dose of an ACE inhibitor/dihydropyridine FDC may rarely trigger a reflex-mediated supraventricular tachyarrhythmia with chest pain in an older patient at high cardiovascular risk. Blood pressure and heart rate monitoring after the first dose, patient education regarding symptoms, and prompt pharmacovigilance reporting are advisable.

AI.tldr: 一例70岁高血压合并2型糖尿病男性首次服用培哚普利/氨氯地平固定复方制剂1小时后出现反射性室上性心动过速伴胸痛，腺苷终止后症状缓解，因果关系评定为很可能。
AI.motivation: ACE抑制剂与二氢吡啶类CCB的固定复方制剂被推荐为多数高血压患者的初始治疗且耐受性良好，但培哚普利/氨氯地平复方制剂此前未见反射性心动过速的报道，临床对首剂后心律失常风险认识不足。

summary_zh: 背景：血管紧张素转换酶（ACE）抑制剂与二氢吡啶类钙通道阻滞剂（CCB）的固定剂量复方制剂（FDC）被推荐作为大多数动脉性高血压患者的初始治疗，且通常耐受性良好。培哚普利/氨氯地平复方制剂此前未见反射性心动过速的报道。病例呈现：一名70岁白人男性，患有动脉性高血压和2型糖尿病，在首次服用AlmirinComb 4/5 mg（培哚普利4 mg/氨氯地平5 mg）1小时后出现胸痛。院前心电图显示室上性心动过速（SVT），经腺苷（6 mg，随后12 mg）终止；转为窦性心律时伴有短暂的下壁ST段压低，胸痛立即缓解。到达医院时，患者无疼痛，血流动力学稳定（血压162/90 mmHg，心率82次/分），呈正常窦性心律，无ST段改变；连续高敏肌钙蛋白I值均在正常范围内。心脏科会诊将事件归因于反射性心动过速。根据世界卫生组织-乌普萨拉监测中心（WHO-UMC）因果关系评估系统，该反应被归类为很可能。患者出院时服用奈必洛尔，并安排了门诊随访（动态心电图、运动试验和超声心动图）。结论：本病例提示，对于心血管高危的老年患者，首次服用ACE抑制剂/二氢吡啶类FDC可能罕见地触发反射介导的室上性快速性心律失常伴胸痛。建议在首次服药后监测血压和心率，对患者进行症状教育，并及时报告药物警戒信息。

title: Left ventricular ejection fraction recovery under contemporary quadruple guideline-directed therapy and the need for ICD/CRT-D implantation in HFrEF: a retrospective single-center cohort study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Guidelines advise deferring primary-prevention implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) or cardiac resynchronization therapy-defibrillator (CRT-D) implantation until left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) is reassessed after at least three months of medical therapy in heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF). Real-world data under contemporary quadruple therapy are limited.

RESEARCH DESIGN AND METHODS: Retrospective single-center cohort of 65 HFrEF patients (Coburg Hospital, Germany; October 2023-December 2024), prescribed beta-blocker, angiotensin receptor-neprilysin inhibitor, mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist and SGLT2 inhibitor (all four in 92%; doses not recorded). LVEF was measured by echocardiography (TTE) and cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) at baseline and ~3 months; reader blinding was not documented. Device implantation followed guideline criteria. Patients with severe arrhythmic events were excluded.

RESULTS: Twenty-nine patients (44.6%) received a device. LVEF rose on TTE (28.0→36.0%) and CMR (26.3→38.5%) (both p < 0.001), mainly without device implantation (TTE +13.0 vs + 1.5 points). Larger baseline left ventricular end-diastolic diameter was associated with smaller recovery (β = -0.41, p = 0.006) and device implantation (odds ratio 1.11/mm, 95% CI 1.01-1.22). Adverse events were not recorded.

CONCLUSIONS: LVEF recovery was common, and associations are consistent with disease severity. Findings are hypothesis-generating; absent dose, arrhythmic-outcome and wearable-defibrillator data and the selected cohort limit generalizability.

AI.tldr: 在当代四联GDMT下，HFrEF患者约3个月LVEF显著恢复，44.6%仍植入ICD/CRT-D，基线左室舒张末径较大与恢复较差及器械植入相关。
AI.motivation: 指南建议HFrEF患者在至少3个月药物治疗后重新评估LVEF，再决定是否植入ICD/CRT-D，但当代四联药物治疗下的真实世界数据有限。
AI.method: 回顾性单中心队列研究，纳入65例HFrEF患者（德国Coburg医院，2023年10月至2024年12月），92%使用四联药物（β受体阻滞剂、ARNI、MRA、SGLT2抑制剂，剂量未记录）。基线和约3个月时通过TTE和CMR测量LVEF，读者盲法未记录。器械植入遵循指南标准，排除严重心律失常事件患者。
AI.result: 29例（44.6%）植入器械。LVEF在TTE（28.0→36.0%）和CMR（26.3→38.5%）上均显著升高（均p<0.001），主要在未植入器械患者中（TTE +13.0 vs +1.5点）。基线左室舒张末径较大与LVEF恢复较小相关（β=-0.41，p=0.006），并与器械植入相关（OR 1.11/mm，95%CI 1.01-1.22）。不良事件未记录。
AI.conclusion: LVEF恢复常见，相关性与疾病严重程度一致。研究为假设生成性，缺乏剂量、心律失常结局和可穿戴除颤器数据，且队列选择限制普遍性。

summary_zh:
背景：指南建议，对于射血分数降低的心力衰竭（HFrEF）患者，在至少三个月的药物治疗后重新评估左心室射血分数（LVEF）之前，应暂缓植入用于一级预防的植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）或心脏再同步治疗除颤器（CRT-D）。当代四联疗法下的真实世界数据有限。

研究设计与方法：回顾性单中心队列研究，纳入65例HFrEF患者（德国科堡医院；2023年10月至2024年12月），处方β受体阻滞剂、血管紧张素受体脑啡肽酶抑制剂、盐皮质激素受体拮抗剂和SGLT2抑制剂（92%的患者使用全部四种药物；剂量未记录）。在基线和约3个月时通过超声心动图（TTE）和心脏磁共振（CMR）测量LVEF；未记录读片者盲法。器械植入遵循指南标准。排除发生严重心律失常事件的患者。

结果：29例患者（44.6%）接受了器械治疗。TTE（28.0→36.0%）和CMR（26.3→38.5%）显示的LVEF均升高（均p < 0.001），主要在未植入器械的患者中（TTE +13.0 vs +1.5点）。较大的基线左心室舒张末期内径与较小的恢复相关（β = -0.41，p = 0.006）并与器械植入相关（比值比1.11/mm，95% CI 1.01-1.22）。未记录不良事件。

title: Lose the Hardware: The Rise of Leadless Modular Cardiac Pacing
summary: Leadless pacemakers have reshaped the approach to cardiac pacing by eliminating transvenous leads and subcutaneous pockets. Since the introduction of the first leadless pacemakers, leadless pacing has advanced from single-chamber ventricular systems to atrioventricular synchronous pacing, standalone atrial pacing, and fully leadless dual-chamber platforms, enabling patient-tailored pacing therapy. The modular leadless pacing concept allows a standalone leadless pacing device to be implanted initially, with additional leadless devices added sequentially as pacing requirements evolve, minimizing unnecessary hardware while preserving the option for future pacing upgrades. This modular approach has expanded to include integration with subcutaneous implantable cardioverter-defibrillators and leadless cardiac resynchronization therapy, moving towards a fully leadless cardiac rhythm management ecosystem. This review summarizes the evolution of leadless pacing, compares currently available devices and their clinical applications, explains leadless pacemaker implantation and end-of-life management, and explores the modular leadless pacing concept as the foundation for future fully leadless cardiac rhythm management.

title: MicraAV Versus Dual-Chamber Transvenous Pacemakers in Patients with Atrioventricular Block Following Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement: A 12-Month Single-Center Retrospective Study
summary: Background: Data directly comparing the atrioventricular (AV)-synchronous leadless pacemaker (MicraAV) with a dual-chamber transvenous pacemaker (DDD) after transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) remain limited. Methods: We retrospectively studied patients undergoing pacemaker implantation for advanced or complete AV block within one month after TAVR at a single Japanese center between 2016 and 2025. After exclusions, the primary cohort comprised 74 patients (MicraAV, n = 29; DDD, n = 45). Clinical outcomes were assessed through 12 months, with death treated as a competing event for nonfatal outcomes. Device and echocardiographic parameters were evaluated longitudinally. Results: MicraAV recipients were less frequently female than DDD recipients (48.3% vs. 75.6%, p = 0.025). In the MicraAV and DDD groups, respectively, all-cause mortality was 6.9% and 6.7% (unadjusted HR, 1.12; 95% CI, 0.19–6.68; p = 0.904), heart failure rehospitalization occurred in 17.2% and 4.4% (subdistribution HR, 4.44; 95% CI, 0.86–22.92; p = 0.075), and device-related complications occurred in 6.9% and 4.4% (subdistribution HR, 1.60; 95% CI, 0.23–11.40; p = 0.636). The median MicraAV tracking index was 88.4% [IQR, 66.4–95.1]. No significant group-by-time interactions were observed for device electrical performance or echocardiographic left ventricular parameters. Tricuspid regurgitation worsened over time in the MicraAV group. Conclusions: All-cause mortality and device-related complications were infrequent in both groups, whereas heart failure rehospitalization occurred more frequently in the MicraAV group. Given the small number of events and wide confidence intervals, these findings should be considered exploratory and require confirmation in larger contemporary cohorts.

title: CARDIAC RESYNCHRONIZATION THERAPY IN PATIENTS WITHOUT TYPICAL LEFT BUNDLE BRANCH BLOCK: A SYSTEMATIC REVIEW OF PATIENT SELECTION STRATEGIES AND EMERGING CONDUCTION SYSTEM PACING ALTERNATIVE
summary: Cardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT) improves outcomes in heart-failure patients with left bundle branch block (LBBB), but benefit in non-LBBB patients (right bundle branch block [RBBB] and non-specific intraventricular conduction delay [IVCD]) is inconsistent and poorly predicted by QRS duration or morphology alone. To synthesize evidence through 2026 on strategies for identifying non-LBBB patients likely to benefit from resynchronization, including electrocardiographic/vectorcardiographic and echocardiographic dyssynchrony markers, and the emerging role of conduction system pacing (CSP) — particularly left bundle branch area pacing (LBBAP) — as an alternative to biventricular pacing (BiVP)A systematic review per PRISMA 2020 methodology, searching MEDLINE, Embase, and Cochrane CENTRAL from inception to 2026 for studies reporting selection criteria or comparative outcomes of resynchronization strategies in adult non-LBBB heart-failure populations. A subset of non-LBBB patients shows correctable left ventricular activation delay; vectorcardiographic QRS area outperforms QRS duration and LBBB criteria in discriminating responders (AUC 0.78 vs 0.62). CSP, particularly LBBAP, produces greater improvements in ejection fraction, reverse remodeling, and heart-failure hospitalization than BiVP in non-LBBB cohorts, though this evidence base remains predominantly observational. Non-LBBB should not be treated as a uniform contraindication to resynchronization. Refined selection tools and conduction system pacing are shifting practice toward individualized selection rather than blanket exclusion. Randomized comparative data remain the principal evidence gap.
journal: World Journal of Biology Pharmacy and Health Sciences

title: FORCED INTRAOPERATIVE MODIFICATION OF PERMANENT CARDIAC PACING TACTICS THROUGH PERSISTENT LEFT SUPERIOR VENA CAVATA IN A HIGH-RISK PATIENT FOR CARDIAC SURGERY: A CASE REPORT
summary: Rationale. Implantation of permanent pacemakers in patients after repeat cardiac surgery can be significantly limited by cicatricial changes, recent cannulations, and obliteration of conventional venous accesses. An additional complication is the presence of congenital variants of systemic venous return, primarily persistent left superior vena cava (PSVC), which alters the geometry of endocardial electrode placement and increases the risk of technical complications. Case Description: This patient presented with a complex cardiac surgical history: aortic coarctation reconstruction in 2013, David I surgery in December 2025, and subsequent emergency hospitalization for decompensated chronic heart failure secondary to aortic valve avulsion and severe aortic regurgitation. On June 10, 2026, the patient underwent repeat aortic valve replacement with a Perceval L seamless biological valve prosthesis for life-saving reasons. In the early postoperative period, manifestations of sick sinus syndrome persisted, with transient second-degree sinoatrial block and pauses up to 3950 ms. Therefore, implantation of a dual-chamber, rate-adaptive pacemaker was planned for June 12, 2026. Intraoperatively, the standard right-sided approach was deemed unacceptable due to a fresh postoperative wound, severe tissue edema, and recent cannulation of the right subclavian artery. Upon conversion to the left subclavian approach, a stented septal vein (SVC) was detected with drainage through the dilated coronary sinus into the right atrium. Given preserved atrioventricular conduction, severe hypocoagulation, thrombocytopenia, and a high risk of coronary sinus injury, a decision was made to abandon the ventricular lead and perform single-chamber atrial pacing in AAIR mode. The lead with active fixation was successfully advanced through the splanchnic vein and the coronary sinus into the right atrium. Conclusion. This clinical observation demonstrates that in a patient with sick sinus syndrome and preserved atrioventricular conduction, AAIR mode can be a reasonable and technically safe option for permanent pacing when standard venous access is impossible and there is a high risk of ventricular lead placement through an anomalous venous collector.

AI.tldr: 在标准静脉入路不可行且存在永存左上腔静脉的高危心脏术后患者中，放弃心室导线、采用AAIR单腔心房起搏是安全可行的替代策略。
AI.motivation: 反复心脏手术后的瘢痕、近期插管及常规静脉入路闭塞会显著限制永久起搏器植入；永存左上腔静脉等先天性体静脉回流变异进一步改变心内膜电极放置的几何构型，增加技术并发症风险。此类高危患者的最佳起搏策略尚缺乏证据。
AI.method: 病例报告。患者有复杂心脏手术史（2013年主动脉缩窄重建、2025年12月David I手术，后因主动脉瓣撕脱并重度反流致慢性心衰失代偿急诊入院），2026年6月10日因救命行再次主动脉瓣置换（Perceval L无缝线生物瓣）。术后早期病态窦房结综合征表现持续，伴短暂二度窦房阻滞及长达3950 ms的停搏，计划2026年6月12日植入双腔频率适应性起搏器。术中因右侧新近手术伤口、严重组织水肿及近期右锁骨下动脉插管，标准右侧入路不可接受；转为左锁骨下入路后检出永存左上腔静脉，经扩张的冠状静脉窦引流入右心房。鉴于房室传导保留、严重低凝状态、血小板减少及冠状静脉窦损伤高风险，决定放弃心室导线，行AAIR模式单腔心房起搏。
AI.result: 摘要未报告起搏参数、手术时间、并发症及随访数据。仅描述主动固定导线经永存左上腔静脉及冠状静脉窦成功送入右心房，未植入心室导线。
AI.conclusion: 对于病态窦房结综合征且房室传导保留的患者，当标准静脉入路不可行、经异常静脉集合系统放置心室导线风险高时，AAIR模式可作为合理且技术安全的永久起搏选择。本病例提示电生理医生在高危心脏术后合并静脉变异时应个体化调整起搏策略；但作为单例报告，结论外推受限，需更多研究验证。

summary_zh: 理由。在再次心脏手术后的患者中植入永久起搏器可能因瘢痕改变、近期插管和常规静脉入路闭塞而受到显著限制。另一个并发症是体静脉回流先天性变异的存在，主要是永存左上腔静脉（PSVC），它改变了心内膜电极放置的几何形态并增加了技术并发症的风险。病例描述：该患者有复杂的心脏手术史：2013年主动脉缩窄重建术，2025年12月David I手术，随后因主动脉瓣撕脱和严重主动脉瓣反流继发的慢性心力衰竭失代偿而急诊住院。2026年6月10日，患者因挽救生命的原因接受了再次主动脉瓣置换术，使用Perceval L无缝生物瓣膜假体。术后早期，病态窦房结综合征的表现持续存在，伴有短暂性二度窦房传导阻滞和长达3950 ms的停搏。因此，计划于2026年6月12日植入双腔频率适应性起搏器。术中，由于新鲜术后伤口、严重组织水肿和近期右锁骨下动脉插管，标准右侧入路被认为不可接受。转为左锁骨下入路后，检测到一支支架置入的隔静脉（SVC），通过扩张的冠状静脉窦引流入右心房。鉴于房室传导保留、严重低凝状态、血小板减少症和冠状静脉窦损伤的高风险，决定放弃心室导线，以AAIR模式进行单腔心房起搏。带有主动固定的导线成功通过内脏静脉和冠状静脉窦推进至右心房。结论。这一临床观察表明，在病态窦房结综合征且房室传导保留的患者中，当标准静脉入路不可能且通过异常静脉集合器放置心室导线存在高风险时，AAIR模式可以是永久起搏的合理且技术安全的选项。

title: The genetic landscape of myotonic dystrophy type 1: insights from nearly one million genomes.
summary: Myotonic Dystrophy type 1 (DM1) is a multisystem disorder caused by CTG repeat expansions in the dystrophia myotonica protein kinase (DMPK) gene. Current prevalence estimates of 1 in 3,000-8,000 have traditionally relied on clinically ascertained and geographically restricted cohorts, underestimating population burden and failing to capture ancestry diversity. Using large-scale whole-genome sequencing (WGS) datasets, we aimed to identify DMPK repeat expansions across nearly one million participants, define their ancestry-specific distribution, and evaluate associated clinical phenotypes, with particular focus on cardiac manifestations and early-onset cataracts. We analysed WGS participants from three cohorts: Genomics England (n = 80,110), UK Biobank (n = 490,086), and the All of Us Research Program (n = 414,830). DMPK repeat lengths were estimated using ExpansionHunter. Alleles were classified as Normal (≤37 repeats), Intermediate (38-49 repeats), or Pathogenic (≥50 repeats). Genetic ancestry was assigned using cohort-specific methods. Linked health record data assessed cardiac phenotypes in UK Biobank and early-onset cataracts in Genomics England and UK Biobank. Across all cohorts (n = 985,026), pathogenic DMPK repeat expansions were identified in 645 individuals (0.07%; ∼1 in 1,527), a prevalence two-to-five times higher than previous estimates. Most expansions occurred in those of European ancestry, although expansions were detected across all groups, including up to 1 in 6,693 African and Asian ancestry. In UK Biobank, individuals with a pathogenic expansion had increased odds of any cardiac diagnosis (odds ratio [OR]: 2.06, 95% confidence interval [CI]: 1.58-2.67; p = 5.8×108) and greater cardiac diagnostic burden (risk ratio 2.46, CI: 1.92-3.15; p = 1.6×10-13). Conduction abnormalities-particularly atrioventricular and left bundle-branch block, atrial fibrillation, and flutter-showed the strongest association with expansion status (OR: 4.86, CI: 3.38-6.79; p = 2.7×10-18). No sex differences were observed among those with a DMPK expansion, although male sex was independently associated with conduction disease in the overall population. Approximately one-in-ten individuals with pathogenic expansions had a cataract diagnosis before age 55. Most individuals with an expansion had no prior DM1 diagnosis, highlighting the value of systematic genetic testing in these phenotypes to improve diagnosis, shorten the diagnostic interval, and mitigate harm. By integrating WGS data from nearly one million individuals, this study refines understanding of the population distribution and clinical consequences of DMPK repeat expansions, revealing a reservoir of undiagnosed and potentially untreated multisystemic disease. These findings support routine inclusion of DMPK analysis within specified cardiac and ophthalmic diagnostic pathways to enable earlier detection.

AI.tldr: 基于近百万全基因组测序数据，DMPK致病性重复扩增的患病率约为1/1527，是既往估计的2-5倍，且与心脏传导异常和早发性白内障显著相关，多数携带者未被临床诊断。
AI.motivation: DM1的患病率估计传统上依赖于临床确诊和地域限制的队列，可能低估了人群负担，且未能反映祖先多样性。本研究旨在利用大规模全基因组测序数据，明确DMPK重复扩增的人群分布、祖先特异性差异及相关临床表型，尤其关注心脏表现和早发性白内障。
AI.method: 研究分析了三个队列的全基因组测序数据：Genomics England（n=80,110）、UK Biobank（n=490,086）和All of Us Research Program（n=414,830），共985,026人。使用ExpansionHunter估计DMPK重复长度，将等位基因分类为正常（≤37次）、中间型（38-49次）或致病性（≥50次）。遗传祖先按队列特定方法分配。通过关联健康记录数据评估UK Biobank中的心脏表型以及Genomics England和UK Biobank中的早发性白内障。
AI.result: 共识别出645例致病性DMPK重复扩增携带者（0.07%，约1/1527），患病率是既往估计的2-5倍。大多数扩增见于欧洲 ancestry，但所有祖先群体中均检测到扩增，非洲和亚洲 ancestry 中高达1/6693。在UK Biobank中，致病性扩增个体任何心脏诊断的比值比（OR）为2.06（95% CI 1.58-2.67；p=5.8×10^-8），心脏诊断负担的风险比为2.46（CI 1.92-3.15；p=1.6×10^-13）。传导异常（尤其是房室和左束支传导阻滞、心房颤动和扑动）与扩增状态的关联最强（OR 4.86，CI 3.38-6.79；p=2.7×10^-18）。在扩增携带者中未观察到性别差异，但男性性别与总体人群中的传导疾病独立相关。约十分之一的致病性扩增个体在55岁前被诊断为白内障。大多数扩增携带者既往无DM1诊断。
AI.conclusion: 通过整合近百万人的全基因组测序数据，本研究更新了对DMPK重复扩增的人群分布和临床后果的认识，揭示了大量未诊断和潜在未治疗的多系统疾病。研究结果支持在特定的心脏和眼科诊断路径中常规纳入DMPK分析，以实现早期发现和干预。

summary_zh: 背景：强直性肌营养不良1型（DM1）是一种由强直性肌营养不良蛋白激酶（DMPK）基因中的CTG重复扩增引起的多系统疾病。目前1/3000-1/8000的患病率估计传统上依赖于临床确诊和地理限制的队列，低估了人群负担且未能捕捉祖先多样性。目的：利用大规模全基因组测序（WGS）数据集，我们旨在近百万参与者中识别DMPK重复扩增，定义其祖先特异性分布，并评估相关的临床表型，特别关注心脏表现和早发性白内障。方法：我们分析了来自三个队列的WGS参与者：Genomics England（n = 80,110）、UK Biobank（n = 490,086）和All of Us Research Program（n = 414,830）。使用ExpansionHunter估计DMPK重复长度。等位基因分类为正常（≤37次重复）、中间型（38-49次重复）或致病性（≥50次重复）。遗传祖先使用队列特异性方法分配。关联的健康记录数据评估了UK Biobank中的心脏表型以及Genomics England和UK Biobank中的早发性白内障。结果：在所有队列中（n = 985,026），645名个体（0.07%；约1/1,527）被鉴定出致病性DMPK重复扩增，患病率比先前估计高两到五倍。大多数扩增发生在欧洲血统个体中，尽管在所有组中都检测到扩增，包括非洲和亚洲血统中高达1/6,693。在UK Biobank中，具有致病性扩增的个体任何心脏诊断的几率增加（比值比[OR]：2.06，95%置信区间[CI]：1.58-2.67；p = 5.8×10-8），且心脏诊断负担更大（风险比2.46，CI：1.92-3.15；p = 1.6×10-13）。传导异常——特别是房室和左束支传导阻滞、心房颤动和扑动——与扩增状态关联最强（OR：4.86，CI：3.38-6.79；p = 2.7×10-18）。在DMPK扩增个体中未观察到性别差异，尽管男性性别在总体人群中独立与传导疾病相关。约十分之一的致病性扩增个体在55岁前被诊断为白内障。大多数扩增个体没有既往DM1诊断，突显了在这些表型中进行系统遗传检测的价值，以改善诊断、缩短诊断间隔并减轻伤害。结论：通过整合近百万个体的WGS数据，本研究完善了对DMPK重复扩增的人群分布和临床后果的理解，揭示了未诊断和可能未治疗的多系统疾病的储存库。这些发现支持在特定的心脏和眼科诊断路径中常规纳入DMPK分析以实现更早检测。

title: sddb-warning-time-tests: power and within-patient tests of HRV-based sudden cardiac death prediction on the MIT-BIH SDDB benchmark
summary: Code for the paper 'Between-database horizon tests do not establish warning times in HRV-based prediction of sudden cardiac death'. It computes HRV features from PhysioNet beat annotations (sddb, nsrdb, chfdb and the heart failure positive-control databases) and runs the horizon test, diseased controls, surrogate onsets, within-patient contrasts with permutation and drift controls, a power simulation with resampled patients, a replication of a published segment-level design, and the heart failure positive control. PhysioNet data are not included; scripts/00_get_data.py downloads the annotation files.
journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

AI.tldr: 该研究通过可复现代码对MIT-BIH SDDB等数据库进行HRV特征分析，发现跨数据库时间窗测试无法证实基于HRV的猝死预测具有真实预警时间。
AI.motivation: 既往基于心率变异性（HRV）的猝死（SCD）预测研究常以跨数据库时间窗测试作为预警能力的证据，但此类设计可能无法真正区分预警时间与疾病状态差异，既往证据存在方法学缺口。
AI.method: 研究为方法学与计算复现研究，基于PhysioNet的sddb、nsrdb、chfdb及心衰阳性对照数据库的逐搏注释计算HRV特征；分析包括时间窗检验、疾病对照、替代发病点、患者内对比（置换检验与漂移控制）、基于重采样患者的功效模拟、已发表片段水平设计的复现以及心衰阳性对照。摘要未报告样本量与具体终点定义。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 跨数据库时间窗测试不能确立HRV猝死预测的预警时间，提示既往相关证据需谨慎解读；该工作提供了可复现代码与患者内检验框架，但摘要未报告定量结果，对电生理临床实践的直接转化价值有限。

summary_zh: 论文《Between-database horizon tests do not establish warning times in HRV-based prediction of sudden cardiac death》的代码。该代码从 PhysioNet 心搏注释（sddb、nsrdb、chfdb 及心力衰竭阳性对照数据库）计算 HRV 特征，并运行 horizon 检验、患病对照、替代发作时间、采用置换与漂移控制的患者内对比、采用重采样患者的功效模拟、对已发表片段水平设计的复现，以及心力衰竭阳性对照。不包含 PhysioNet 数据；scripts/00_get_data.py 下载注释文件。

title: Cardiac phenotype in children with X-linked ichthyosis (STS-sEDD): findings from a prospective cohort.
summary:
X-linked ichthyosis is caused by pathogenic variants or deletions involving STS at Xp22.31. Because some deletions include contiguous genes and cardiac rhythm abnormalities have been reported, we characterized the cardiac phenotype of children with genetically confirmed steroid sulfatase-related syndromic epidermal differentiation disorder (STS-sEDD). This prospective, observational, single-centre study included 14 boys aged 2-16 years. Assessment comprised clinical history and examination, 12-lead electrocardiography, echocardiography, exercise testing when age-appropriate, and 5-day ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring. Genetic findings were reviewed, and 11 obligate-carrier mothers also underwent cardiological assessment. Nine patients (64%) were asymptomatic and five (36%) reported mild, nonspecific symptoms. Minor electrocardiographic findings in 11 patients were considered age-appropriate variants. All hearts were structurally normal except for one previously known, haemodynamically compensated partial anomalous pulmonary venous return. Exercise testing in 12 patients identified one isolated premature ventricular contraction; 5-day monitoring in 13 detected no clinically significant arrhythmia. Twelve patients had contiguous-gene deletions and two had pathogenic STS sequence variants, with no apparent association between deletion extent and cardiac findings. Maternal echocardiograms were normal; one mother had isolated atrial and ventricular ectopy during exercise without clinically significant arrhythmia.

CONCLUSION: Clinically relevant cardiac involvement appeared uncommon in this small pediatric cohort. The sample size and cross-sectional assessment preclude definitive risk estimates; cardiological evaluation should be individualized according to symptoms, cardiovascular findings, and family history.

WHAT IS KNOWN: • X-linked ichthyosis is caused by STS variants or deletions that may involve contiguous genes. • Cardiac arrhythmias have been reported with Xp22.31 deletions, but pediatric data are scarce.

WHAT IS NEW: • No clinically significant arrhythmia was found in 14 boys undergoing multimodal assessment. • Deletion extent did not predict cardiac findings; follow-up should reflect symptoms and family history.

AI.tldr: 14例STS-sEDD男童中，多模态心脏评估未发现临床显著心律失常，心脏结构基本正常，缺失范围与心脏表现无关。
AI.motivation: X连锁鱼鳞病由STS基因变异或Xp22.31缺失所致，部分缺失累及相邻基因，既往有心脏节律异常报道，但儿科数据匮乏，需明确该人群心脏表型以指导评估策略。
AI.method: 前瞻性、观察性、单中心队列研究，纳入14例基因确诊的STS-sEDD男童（2-16岁），评估包括病史与体格检查、12导联心电图、超声心动图、适龄运动负荷试验及5天动态心电图监测；回顾基因结果，并对11例必然携带者母亲行心脏评估。
AI.result: 9例（64%）无症状，5例（36%）有轻度非特异性症状；11例心电图轻微改变视为年龄相关变异；除1例已知血流动力学代偿的部分性肺静脉异位引流外，心脏结构均正常；12例运动试验中1例出现孤立性室性早搏，13例5天动态心电图未检出临床显著心律失常；12例为相邻基因缺失，2例为STS致病性序列变异，缺失范围与心脏表现无明显关联；母亲超声心动图正常，1例运动时出现孤立性房性与室性异位搏动，无临床显著心律失常。
AI.conclusion: 本小样本儿科队列中临床相关心脏受累不常见；样本量与横断面设计限制风险估计，心脏评估应根据症状、心血管发现及家族史个体化进行。

summary_zh:
X连锁鱼鳞病由Xp22.31区域累及STS的致病性变异或缺失引起。由于部分缺失包含相邻基因，且已有心脏节律异常的报道，我们对经基因确诊的类固醇硫酸酯酶相关综合征性表皮分化障碍（STS-sEDD）患儿的心脏表型进行了特征描述。这项前瞻性、观察性、单中心研究纳入了14名2-16岁男孩。评估包括临床病史和体格检查、12导联心电图、超声心动图、适龄时的运动试验以及5天动态心电监测。回顾了遗传学发现，11名必然携带者母亲也接受了心脏病学评估。9名患者（64%）无症状，5名（36%）报告了轻微、非特异性症状。11名患者的心电图轻微发现被认为是与年龄相符的变异。除了一例已知的、血流动力学代偿的部分性肺静脉异位引流外，所有心脏结构均正常。12名患者的运动试验发现一例孤立性室性早搏；13名患者的5天监测未检测到有临床意义的心律失常。12名患者存在相邻基因缺失，2名患者存在致病性STS序列变异，缺失范围与心脏发现之间无明显关联。母亲超声心动图正常；一位母亲在运动期间出现孤立性房性和室性异位搏动，无临床意义的心律失常。

结论：在这个小型儿科队列中，临床相关的心脏受累似乎不常见。样本量和横断面评估妨碍了确定性的风险估计；心脏病学评估应根据症状、心血管发现和家族史进行个体化。

已知信息：• X连锁鱼鳞病由可能累及相邻基因的STS变异或缺失引起。• 已有Xp22.31缺失伴发心律失常的报道，但儿科数据稀缺。

新发现：• 在接受多模式评估的14名男孩中未发现有临床意义的心律失常。• 缺失范围不能预测心脏发现；随访应反映症状和家族史。

title: A penalized, synergistic deep learning architecture leveraging DBN and GAN for classifying highly asymmetric medical data: A multi-domain validation
summary: Detecting ECG-based arrhythmias early and accurately is challenging due to significant class imbalance, noise, and privacy barriers across medical institutions. This paper proposes a penalized, synergistic deep learning solution comprising: (i) Deep Belief Networks (DBN) for hierarchical representation learning, (ii) Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) for augmenting the minority class with DBN feature conditioning, and (iii) a novel adaptive cost-sensitive penalty coefficient that dynamically adjusts based on training dynamics and class distribution to enhance classification robustness. Our key innovations include: (1) a feedback mechanism where DBN features condition GAN generation and GAN samples inform DBN training; (2) a dynamic penalty function with adaptive formulation; and (3) the first comprehensive multi-domain validation of such synergistic architecture across four diverse imbalanced datasets. Evaluation on MIT-BIH (patient-wise split, 9 classes), PTB-XL (5 diagnostic superclasses), CPSC-2018,(9 rhythm classes), and a real-world credit card fraud detection dataset demonstrates state-of-the-art performance with 99.47% ± 0.10% accuracy and 0.9905 ± 0.004 MCC on MIT-BIH, with strong cross-domain generalization. The same framework can potentially be extended to Federated Learning for privacy-preserving training, which we discuss as a future direction.

title: Motion Artifacts Quantification in Ambulatory Holter ECG Across Age Groups: Insights from Simultaneous 3-Axis Accelerometry
summary: Ambulatory Holter electrocardiogram (ECG) monitoring is increasingly used in ambulatory elderly populations; however, age-related physiological and mechanical factors substantially increase susceptibility to motion-induced signal artifacts, limiting reliable heart rate (HR) variability (HRV) analysis. This study aims to quantify age-group differences in motion artifact burden and to establish an age-stratified noise model using simultaneous ECG and three-axis accelerometry. Twenty participants—15 elderly patients (elderly male: OM, n = 10; elderly female: OF, n = 5) and five young males (young male: YM, n = 5)—underwent ambulatory ECG recording during daily life activities. The simultaneous acquisition of three-channel ECG and triaxial acceleration data enables quantitative characterization of motion-induced noise in the R–R interval (RRI) time series. We present a data processing pipeline that (1) extracts RRI sequences and computes a comprehensive set of heart rate variability (HRV) metrics (time-domain, frequency-domain, and nonlinear), (2) computes per-epoch accelerometer root mean square (RMS) as a motion intensity proxy, and (3) correlates motion intensity with RRI artifact rate across age groups. Key findings: Artifact rate was highest in OM (1.9 ± 4.7%) versus OF (0.9 ± 0.9%) and YM (0.3 ± 0.6%); standard deviation (SD) of all normal-to-normal intervals (SDNN) was 72.7 ± 26.5 ms (OM), 95.8 ± 71.8 ms (OF), and 79.6 ± 6.7 ms (YM); and low-frequency-to-high-frequency power ratio (LF/HF) was notably higher in YM (5.04 ± 3.52) than in elderly groups (OM: 1.53; OF: 1.08). Epoch accelerometer RMS was modestly higher in YM (0.317 g) than in elderly groups (OM: 0.306 g; OF: 0.302 g). The findings establish a quantitative framework for age-stratified noise modeling in wearable ECG devices, with direct implications for motion-robust R-peak detection algorithm design. The concurrent availability of ECG and inertial data from a single IEC 60601-certified device distinguishes this dataset from prior art and strengthens its value for signal processing research.
